desc:
Start as a UAP and work your way up to Chief of Nursing! Ages 9+ can now play!

Care for real-feeling patients in a fully built hospital: check vitals, give meds, start IVs, chart at the nurses' station and respond to hospital codes. Every patient you treat right earns points, pay and promotions.

- Career ladder: UAP > CNA > LPN > RN (ASN) > RN (BSN) > Charge Nurse > Nurse Practitioner > Nurse Manager > Director of Nursing > Chief Nursing Officer
- Med-Surg, Children's Wing, OR and more
- Daily shift bonus - come back every day for bigger rewards
- Scrubs shop - unlock new scrub colors as you get promoted
- Earn badges for promotions and milestones
- Extremely Mobile friendly even for Phones.

Great for nursing and medical students who want to practice - and for anyone who loves hospital roleplay!

Join Fully Studios for updates and sneak peeks..
